summary: Railway production telemetry repeatedly emits one adsb_outlier_rejected WARNING per rejected aircraft on five-second cycles, overwhelmingly for jump_km=0.00. The rejection behavior itself is retained; the defect is unbounded repetitive diagnostics capable of flooding Railway logs.
conclusion: Confirmed logging/reliability defect. The smallest safe correction rate-limits only repetitive zero-jump diagnostics, preserves every ADS-B rejection decision, preserves non-zero-jump warnings, and reports the suppressed repeat count on the next emitted diagnostic.

evidence.source: Railway production telemetry inspected by TASK 2
evidence.production_symptom: adsb_outlier_rejected warning bursts recurring on the five-second monitoring cadence, dominated by jump_km=0.00
